definition: A form reporting miscellaneous income payments and nonemployee compensation made in the course of trade or business, including rents, royalties, fishing proceeds, attorney payments, crop insurance, medical payments, and various other income categories, along with federal income tax withheld.

includes.text: Reports rents, royalties, and other miscellaneous income from various sources
Reports nonemployee compensation and independent contractor payments
Reports federal income tax withheld on reportable payments

excludes.text: Does not report dividend and distribution payments that are reported on a different form
Does not report mortgage interest statements which appear on a different form
Does not report interest income which is reported on a different form

discriminators.text: Reports miscellaneous income including rents, royalties, and other payments; the sibling reports only dividend and distribution payments
Reports various business payments and nonemployee compensation; the sibling reports only mortgage interest paid by borrowers
Reports miscellaneous business income and payments; the sibling reports only interest income from savings and investments
